# APT-PLAN-F2 — Tool parameters read as a map

> Batch F2 of `APT-PLAN.md`. Spec: `todo/apt/SPEC-apt.md`.

## Intent
A tool call whose arguments arrive as a JSON object is read into a typed parameter map, refused with a
named error when a required parameter is missing or of the wrong kind, and the map is what the tool
receives. **Ids**: BR-04, BR-05, BR-06 / UC-02. **Depends on**: F1

## Design
| Point | Decision |
|-------|----------|
| Applied rules | DDD-01, DDD-02, DDD-03, APP-01, APP-02, PERF-01 |
| Owning aggregate | `ParameterSchema`; `ToolInvoker` only orchestrates the read and the call |
| Invariants | BR-04 (a required parameter is present), BR-05 (the kind matches the schema); removes the `TryGetProperty` ladder of `ToolInvoker.InvokeAsync` |
| Consistency | one call reads the arguments once, no write |
| Events | N/A — reading arguments changes no state |
| Access cost | 0 reads + 0 writes, independent of the input |

## Decisions
- 2026-10-14: `ParameterSchema.ReadAsMap` returns `Result<ParameterMap, ParameterError>` rather than throwing:
  the invoker already maps `Result` failures to tool errors (`ToolInvoker.cs:88`), an exception would add a
  second path for the same refusal.
- 2026-10-14: the map keeps the JSON element of each value (`JsonElement`), not a converted CLR value: the
  tools of F3 convert on demand, and a conversion here would be paid for parameters no tool reads.
- 2026-10-14: `ParameterError` is a closed set of three cases (`Missing`, `WrongKind`, `Unknown`), each
  carrying the parameter name; `Unknown` is reported, not refused (BR-06: an extra argument is tolerated).

## TDD sequence
Every test below is written and red before any production line of its step. Order inside a step:
success first (it fixes the signatures), refusals next, integration last.
Declarative artefacts written without a prior red test: `ParameterMap` (a record over a dictionary) —
covered by the test of the behaviour it serves (pure declarations: a DTO, a registration, a configuration
entry; never a branch).

### Step 1 — Read the arguments of a call into a parameter map
| # | Test | Level | Project | Ids |
|---|------|-------|---------|-----|
| 1 | `ShouldReadEveryDeclaredParameter_WhenArgumentsMatchTheSchema` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-04 |
| 2 | `ShouldKeepTheJsonElementOfEachValue_WhenArgumentsAreRead` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-04 |
| 3 | `ShouldReadAnEmptyMap_WhenTheSchemaDeclaresNoParameter` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-04 |

Tests 1 and 2 merge into one cycle: the second only adds an assertion on the element kept.

TDD: RED [ ] GREEN [ ] COST [ ]

### Step 2 — Refuse a call whose required parameter is missing
| # | Test | Level | Project | Ids |
|---|------|-------|---------|-----|
| 1 | `ShouldRefuseWithMissing_WhenARequiredParameterIsAbsent` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-04 |
| 2 | `ShouldNameTheFirstMissingParameter_WhenSeveralAreAbsent` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-04 |
| 3 | `ShouldReadTheMap_WhenAnOptionalParameterIsAbsent` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-04 |

TDD: RED [ ] GREEN [ ] COST [ ]

### Step 3 — Refuse a parameter of the wrong kind
| # | Test | Level | Project | Ids |
|---|------|-------|---------|-----|
| 1 | `ShouldRefuseWithWrongKind_WhenANumberArrivesAsAString` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-05 |
| 2 | `ShouldRefuseWithWrongKind_WhenAnObjectArrivesAsAnArray` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-05 |
| 3 | `ShouldAcceptNull_WhenTheParameterIsNullable` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-05 |

The kind table of `ParameterSchema` (`ParameterSchema.cs:41`) is the only source: no second switch.

TDD: RED [ ] GREEN [ ] COST [ ]

### Step 4 — Report an argument the schema does not declare
| # | Test | Level | Project | Ids |
|---|------|-------|---------|-----|
| 1 | `ShouldReportUnknown_WhenAnArgumentIsNotDeclared` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-06 |
| 2 | `ShouldStillReadTheMap_WhenAnUnknownArgumentIsReported` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | BR-06 |
| 3 | `ShouldInvokeTheToolWithTheMap_WhenTheCallIsValid` | integration | `Orkeon.Tools.IntegrationTests` | UC-02 |

Test 3 runs the invoker over the in-memory tool registry of F1: no Docker.

TDD: RED [ ] GREEN [ ] COST [ ]

### Step 5 — Hand the map to the tool, never the raw arguments
| # | Test | Level | Project | Ids |
|---|------|-------|---------|-----|
| 1 | `ShouldPassTheParameterMap_WhenTheToolIsInvoked` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | UC-02 |
| 2 | `ShouldReturnInvalidArguments_WhenTheMapCannotBeRead` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | UC-02, BR-04 |
| 3 | `ShouldNotCallTheTool_WhenTheMapCannotBeRead` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | UC-02 |
| 4 | `ShouldCarryTheParameterName_WhenInvalidArgumentsIsReturned` | unit | `Orkeon.Tools.Tests` | UC-02, BR-05 |

`ITool.ExecuteAsync(JsonElement, CancellationToken)` is replaced, not overloaded: the three tools of the
registry are updated in the same step (`EchoTool`, `ClockTool`, `ReadFileTool`), each a one-line change.

TDD: RED [ ] GREEN [ ] COST [ ]

### Step 6 — Build and tests
No new test: the scopes of `## Test policy and scopes`.

## Test policy and scopes
**Fast suite**: `dotnet test tests/Orkeon.Tools.Tests --no-build` (the whole project: 212 tests, 9 s).
**Integration**: `dotnet test tests/Orkeon.Tools.IntegrationTests --no-build --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ToolInvoker"`.
**Not run**: `Orkeon.Agents.IntegrationTests` — no reference to `Orkeon.Tools` changed in its graph.

## Code elements
Domain (`src/Orkeon.Tools/Schema/`):
- `ParameterMap` — `public sealed record ParameterMap(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JsonElement> Values)`;
  `bool TryGet(string name, out JsonElement value)`. Declaration only.
- `ParameterError` — `public abstract record ParameterError(string Name)` with `Missing(string Name)`,
  `WrongKind(string Name, JsonValueKind Expected, JsonValueKind Actual)`, `Unknown(string Name)`.
- `ParameterSchema.ReadAsMap` — `public Result<ParameterMap, ParameterError> ReadAsMap(JsonElement arguments)`;
  enforces BR-04 (required present) and BR-05 (kind matches); BR-06 reported through `Unknown`, never refused.

Application (`src/Orkeon.Tools/Invocation/`):
- `ToolInvoker.InvokeAsync` — reads the arguments through `ParameterSchema.ReadAsMap` and passes the map
  to `ITool.ExecuteAsync(ParameterMap, CancellationToken)`; a failure becomes `ToolError.InvalidArguments`
  with the parameter name (`ToolInvoker.cs:88`, the mapping of F1).

- `ITool.ExecuteAsync` — `Task<ToolResult> ExecuteAsync(ParameterMap parameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken)`;
  replaces the `JsonElement` overload (Step 5). The three built-in tools read their values through
  `ParameterMap.TryGet`; none converts a value the schema did not declare.
- `ToolError.InvalidArguments` — existing (`src/Orkeon.Tools/Invocation/ToolError.cs:27`); gains the
  parameter name of the `ParameterError` it carries, nothing else.

Adapters: none — the registry of F1 is reused as it is.

## Anchors
`/dev-implement` copies these paths into its delegations and searches for nothing. One row per step (a
step whose tests land in two files splits into `1 — <title> (integration)`). Column 3 lists the shared
doubles and builders to extend, with the member to add; column 4 is the only production files the
implementer may touch.

| Step | Test class / fixture | Shared doubles and builders | Production filled or created |
|------|----------------------|-----------------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 — Read the arguments of a call into a parameter map | `tests/Orkeon.Tools.Tests/Schema/ParameterSchemaReadAsMapTests.cs` — to create | `tests/Orkeon.Tools.Tests/Builders/SchemaBuilder.cs:12` (`WithParameter` to add) | `src/Orkeon.Tools/Schema/ParameterSchema.cs:110` — `ReadAsMap`; `src/Orkeon.Tools/Schema/ParameterMap.cs` — to create |
| 2 — Refuse a call whose required parameter is missing | `tests/Orkeon.Tools.Tests/Schema/ParameterSchemaReadAsMapTests.cs` | `tests/Orkeon.Tools.Tests/Builders/SchemaBuilder.cs:12` (`Required` to add) | `src/Orkeon.Tools/Schema/ParameterSchema.cs:110` — `ReadAsMap`; `src/Orkeon.Tools/Schema/ParameterError.cs` — to create |
| 3 — Refuse a parameter of the wrong kind | `tests/Orkeon.Tools.Tests/Schema/ParameterSchemaReadAsMapTests.cs` | — | `src/Orkeon.Tools/Schema/ParameterSchema.cs:41` — the kind table |
| 4 — Report an argument the schema does not declare | `tests/Orkeon.Tools.Tests/Schema/ParameterSchemaReadAsMapTests.cs` | — | `src/Orkeon.Tools/Schema/ParameterSchema.cs:110` — `ReadAsMap` |
| 4 — Report an argument the schema does not declare (integration) | `tests/Orkeon.Tools.IntegrationTests/Invocation/ToolInvokerTests.cs:30` — existing | `tests/Orkeon.Tools.IntegrationTests/Doubles/InMemoryToolRegistry.cs:18` (`RegisterEcho` to add) | `src/Orkeon.Tools/Invocation/ToolInvoker.cs:88` — `InvokeAsync` |
| 5 — Hand the map to the tool, never the raw arguments | `tests/Orkeon.Tools.Tests/Invocation/ToolInvokerTests.cs:22` — existing | `tests/Orkeon.Tools.Tests/Doubles/RecordingTool.cs:9` (`LastMap` to add) | `src/Orkeon.Tools/Invocation/ToolInvoker.cs:88` — `InvokeAsync`; `src/Orkeon.Tools/ITool.cs:14` — `ExecuteAsync`; `src/Orkeon.Tools/Builtin/EchoTool.cs:20`, `ClockTool.cs:17`, `ReadFileTool.cs:31` — `ExecuteAsync` |
| 6 — Build and tests | — | — | — |

| # | Assumption | To be validated by |
|---|------------|--------------------|
